recorded: A bound agent receives no unrestricted or raw network egress; network is a typed capability the agent may request, Runtime decides, and the capability host enforces.
satisfied_when: Every harness firstmate can launch composes a session whose permission enforcement is active, AND the capability catalog's network.request row names an owner and a verifier that both exist. Both halves are probed below and composed by three-valued AND, so neither can retire this entry alone.
note: The ruling has two halves and both are now observed. Until 2026-08-18 this entry declared that second half in unobserved_conditions on the stated ground that the catalog existed only as a proposal in data/cfvc-harness-and-capability/report.md section 6.3; capabilities/catalog.json landed as tracked code on 2026-08-10, before this entry was written on 2026-08-11, so that ground was already false when it was recorded and the register was printing it as evidence at every session start. Replacing the declaration with a probe is strictly stronger: could-not-observe became observed-bad, and the entry still cannot retire on either half. Neither half is satisfiable by this register. The launch half retires only when bindings and adapters are proven, because removing a bypass flag first disarms every lane and enforces nothing. The catalog half is captain-owned: the report's exception E-07 records its retirement evidence as a named workload plus a captain decision on egress scope, the 2026-08-06 ruling authorises no concrete grant, and tests/fm-capability-catalog.test.sh pins network.request unowned - which is also what stops this probe being made green by writing any path into that row.
